name: Auto Vehicle Parts LLC
about:
Auto Vehicle Parts LLC, doing business as Auveco, is headquartered in Cold Spring, Kentucky. The current limited liability company was formed in 2023, but the Auveco brand has been manufacturing and distributing specialty automotive and industrial fasteners for over 100 years. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in public materials.

The company supplies what it describes as the largest selection of body hardware and specialty fasteners, including clips, retainers, and related components. Its product portfolio encompasses monthly new item releases, unit boxes, bulk quantities, and the proprietary AuvecoPaks—single-price small bags designed for retail displays—as well as assortment kits and merchandising aids. Auveco also provides technical support and product identification services to help customers locate the correct part.

Auveco serves the automotive and industrial sectors, with a focus on the body hardware industry. Its customers range from repair shops and distributors to retail outlets that use the AuvecoPaks program. The company’s customer service team operates Monday through Friday, Eastern Time, handling inquiries on availability, pricing, delivery, and technical specifications.

Auveco cites four core values as differentiators: a customer-first approach, a sense of urgency that drives same-day shipping on stocked items, transparency in product information and processes, and continuous improvement fueled by customer feedback. The company states its goal remains the same as it was a century ago: complete customer satisfaction.
